# Replays recorded LLM answers (data/llm_recorded.csv) instead of calling a real LLM,
# by pretending to be a local Ollama server (ellmer::chat_ollama), the Anthropic API (ellmer::chat_anthropic)
# or the OpenAI Responses API (ellmer::chat_openai)
llm_recorded <- readr::read_csv("data/llm_recorded.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
# ellmer's coro generators get byte-compiled again on every request, which makes replaying
# hundreds of answers take minutes; without the JIT compiler it takes seconds
invisible(compiler::enableJIT(0))
# An empty system prompt is stored as an empty field, which read_csv turns into NA
llm_recorded$prompt[is.na(llm_recorded$prompt)] <- ""
# Squish whitespace so that e.g. spreading the prompt over multiple lines still matches;
# computed once here, as the mock is called for every single request
llm_key <- function(model, prompt, text) paste(model, stringr::str_squish(prompt), stringr::str_squish(text), sep = "\r")
llm_recorded_keys <- llm_key(llm_recorded$model, llm_recorded$prompt, llm_recorded$text)
# chat_anthropic() and chat_openai() refuse to start without a key; the mock never uses it
if (Sys.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY") == "") Sys.setenv(ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "not-needed-for-recorded-answers")
if (Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY") == "") Sys.setenv(OPENAI_API_KEY = "not-needed-for-recorded-answers")

# Shortcut for the common case: if all prompts are recorded, return the recorded answers directly.
# Replaying hundreds of answers through ellmer is too slow in the browser.
# Otherwise fall back to the real function, which then goes through the httr2 mock below.
parallel_chat_text <- function(chat, prompts, ...) {
  system <- chat$get_system_prompt()
  if (is.null(system)) system <- ""
  answers <- llm_recorded$answer[match(llm_key(chat$get_model(), system, as.character(prompts)), llm_recorded_keys)]
  if (!anyNA(answers)) return(answers)
  ellmer::parallel_chat_text(chat, prompts, ...)
}

options(httr2_mock = function(req) {
  path <- httr2::url_parse(req$url)$path
  if (path == "/api/tags") {
    # Only report the local (Ollama) models as installed, not the hosted ones like Claude
    local_models <- unique(llm_recorded$model[!stringr::str_detect(llm_recorded$model, "^(claude|gpt)")])
    models <- lapply(local_models, \(m) list(
      name = m, model = m, modified_at = "2026-10-01T12:00:00Z", size = 2019393189, digest = "recorded"))
    return(httr2::response_json(url = req$url, body = list(models = models)))
  }
  if (path == "/api/show") {
    return(httr2::response_json(url = req$url, body = list(capabilities = list("completion"))))
  }
  body <- req$body$data
  anthropic <- path == "/v1/messages"
  openai <- path == "/v1/responses"
  # Message content is either a plain string or a list of parts with a $text field
  content_text <- function(content) {
    if (is.character(content)) content else paste(vapply(content, \(part) part$text, ""), collapse = "")
  }
  messages <- if (openai) body$input else body$messages
  roles <- vapply(messages, \(m) m$role, "")
  # The system prompt is optional: the book's examples put all instructions in the user message
  system <- if (anthropic && !is.null(body$system)) content_text(body$system) else
    if (any(roles == "system")) content_text(messages[[which(roles == "system")[1]]]$content) else ""
  text <- content_text(messages[[length(messages)]]$content)
  answer <- llm_recorded$answer[match(llm_key(body$model, system, text), llm_recorded_keys)]
  if (is.na(answer)) {
    explanation <- paste(
      "I'm sorry, Dave, I'm afraid I can't let you do that :(\n",
      "\nDon't worry, nothing went wrong. It's just that unfortunately to get LLMs working",
      "in the interactive examples, we had to pre-record all the messages.",
      "So, it can only replay the answers we recorded for the exact prompts and texts in the examples.",
      "If you change the prompt or the texts, there is no recorded answer.",
      "To try your own prompts, run this code in R on your own computer with a real LLM.")
    # cat() rather than message(), so it still shows in chunks with `message: false`
    cat("\n\n", explanation, "\n\n")
    error <- list(message = explanation, type = "no_recorded_answer")
    error_body <- if (anthropic) list(type = "error", error = error) else list(error = error)
    return(httr2::response_json(url = req$url, status_code = 400, body = error_body))
  }
  if (anthropic) {
    return(httr2::response_json(url = req$url, body = list(
      id = "recorded", type = "message", role = "assistant", model = body$model,
      content = list(list(type = "text", text = answer[1])),
      stop_reason = "end_turn", usage = list(input_tokens = 0, output_tokens = 0)
    )))
  }
  if (openai) {
    return(httr2::response_json(url = req$url, body = list(
      id = "recorded", object = "response", status = "completed", model = body$model,
      output = list(list(type = "message", id = "recorded", role = "assistant", status = "completed",
                         content = list(list(type = "output_text", text = answer[1], annotations = list())))),
      usage = list(input_tokens = 0, output_tokens = 0, total_tokens = 0)
    )))
  }
  httr2::response_json(url = req$url, body = list(
    id = "recorded", object = "chat.completion", created = 0, model = body$model,
    choices = list(list(index = 0, finish_reason = "stop",
                        message = list(role = "assistant", content = answer[1]))),
    usage = list(prompt_tokens = 0, completion_tokens = 0, total_tokens = 0)
  ))
})
